summary: Iteration 2 polish verified end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest pass (4 new persistence/history tests + 6 existing). Frontend: all 13 user-facing scenarios pass — P2SH/P2PKH/P2WPKH hash160 decoding in-browser, lock-target writes LOCK lines to terminal with hash160, header TARGET chip renders, terminal pause/resume toggles EventSource correctly, clear empties feed, run-inversion + export JSON download contains all required fields, copy WIF clipboard wrapped in try/catch, mobile 375x812 scrolls vertically with all panels visible.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 162 references `logger` inside the persistence try/except, but `logger` is defined on line 249 AFTER the route definitions. Since route handlers run at request time (after module import completes), this works in practice but is fragile. Move logger config above route definitions.
MongoDB persistence has no index on `created_at`; with growing collections sort will be slow. Add a descending index on `created_at` at startup.

decodeAddress in /app/frontend/src/lib/btc.js uses Array.from(bytes) which is fine for Uint8Array, but bs58check v3+ returns Uint8Array — ensure package.json pins compatible version (verified working in test run).
SultanTerminal: lock-target effect depends on [target?.address, target?.hash160] — if user locks the same address twice in a row (same refs), no new LOCK line is emitted. Minor UX corner case.
/api/inversion/history has no auth/rate-limit; in a real deployment this would be an info-disclosure surface. Acceptable for this simulation app.
seed_data_creation: Created several inversion records in MongoDB via /api/inversion/run; final test deletes all via DELETE /api/inversion/history.
